title: Tool calls in a row fold into one line
body:
`Transcript::entries` in `src/session.rs` holds one `Entry::Tool` per tool call, and the screen draws each call on its own line with a blank line after it. An edit adds a `+N -M` line under its call. A turn that makes nine calls in a row takes about eighteen rows, which pushes the conversation around it off the screen.

## Proposal

- A run is two or more `Entry::Tool` in a row. An agent reply, a person's message, a thought or a notice ends it. An `Entry::Permission` row inside a run stays in it.
- A run draws folded as one line: a status dot, the number of calls, the count of each kind, and the run's combined diff, with `▸` at the right. While a call in the run is in progress, the line also shows that call's title.
- A click on the line unfolds the run into the calls as they draw today, each still foldable on its own. A second click folds it again. The fold state is kept under the first call's id.
- The grouping happens at draw time, so a session loaded through `session/load` groups the same way and the session model does not change.
- A single call between other entries draws as it does today.
- A sub-agent's `agent` line counts as one call in its parent's run.

Jack settled that a thought ends a run and that runs start at two calls. He refines the folded line once a first version is on screen.
